_comment: Per-character nudges for character clips (docs/15_ANIMATION.md, 'Characters'; e.g. media/anim/archer_bow.anim).
A character clip is made with one character and fitted to any other automatically: its 'hand' (where the bow is
held) keeps its share of the visible body's height and its distance from the body's right edge, measured from the
sprite's pixels. A character whose hand still looks off gets an entry here: the sprite name and the hand's extra
move in pixels, x right and y down. Example: "player_viking": { "hand": [0, -1] } lifts the bow one pixel.
A character not listed needs nothing.
